name: pdh_runway

Lane funnel+runway 2-of-4 (0.546/0.543 beat, 0.485/0.519 lose), margin <+0.05R - feeds b70 as a marginal lane, nothing earned a slot. NOT wired. Ledger: data/backtest/b68p_runway_confirm.json.
